swapped_ends(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex swapped_ends([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
  ex swapped_ends([7]) == [7]
  ex swapped_ends([]) == []
  ex swapped_ends([1, 2]) == [2, 1]
  let n = xs.len()
  var ys: List[int] = []
  for i in range(0, n)
    var v = xs[i]
    if n > 1
      if i == 0
        v = xs[n - 1]
      if i == n - 1
        v = xs[0]
    ys.append(v)
  ys

swap_ends(var xs: List[int]) =
  ex swapped_ends([4, 5, 6, 7]) == [7, 5, 6, 4]
  let n = xs.len()
  if n >= 2
    let first = xs[0]
    let last = xs[n - 1]
    xs[0] = last
    xs[n - 1] = first
